verdict.rationale: Wrike's own docs say Wrike Copilot answers questions and summarizes work, and AI insights turn work data into intelligence, so the core Q&A capability over workspace content is first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows answers cite their source workspace items, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented citations or source attribution in AI answers, evidence of retrieval scope across workspace content (tasks, docs, attachments), independent or hands-on validation of answer quality and speed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content

citations.quote: Wrike Copilot answers questions, summarizes work, and keeps your team moving
Wrike AI insights turn raw work data into clear, actionable intelligence.
